question: Where do people actually get money back after a complaint?
dataset: a public dataset: a 3% sample (38,943 rows) of the 2023 consumer complaints published by the U.S. Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, a U.S. government source in the public domain. Company names and complaint text were left out

findings.title: Monetary relief rate varies by product: Prepaid card 36.9% versus Credit reporting 0.1%
findings.so_what: Prepaid card is about 645.9 times Credit reporting.
findings.headline: Monetary relief rate differs by product: Prepaid card is highest at 36.9%, Credit reporting is lowest at 0.1% (64489% apart).
reasoning: Based on 103 and 17,507 rows; the gap is about 71.5 standard errors, well beyond chance.
why: Based on 103 Prepaid card rows and 17,507 Credit reporting rows.
Random sampling alone would almost never produce a gap this large.
findings.confidence_note: Far larger than random ups and downs can explain.

findings.sql: SELECT "product" AS grp, COUNT((CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM("monetary_relief")) IN ('1', '1.0', 'true', 'yes', 'y', 't') THEN 1 WHEN "monetary_relief" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END)) AS n, AVG((CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM("monetary_relief")) IN ('1', '1.0', 'true', 'yes', 'y', 't') THEN 1 WHEN "monetary_relief" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END)) AS mean, SUM((CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM("monetary_relief")) IN ('1', '1.0', 'true', 'yes', 'y', 't') THEN 1 WHEN "monetary_relief" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END)*(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM("monetary_relief")) IN ('1', '1.0', 'true', 'yes', 'y', 't') THEN 1 WHEN "monetary_relief" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END)) AS sq, COUNT(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM("monetary_relief")) IN ('1', '1.0', 'true', 'yes', 'y', 't') THEN 1 WHEN "monetary_relief" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 1 END) AS npos, AVG(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM("monetary_relief")) IN ('1', '1.0', 'true', 'yes', 'y', 't') THEN 1 WHEN "monetary_relief" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN ln((CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM("monetary_relief")) IN ('1', '1.0', 'true', 'yes', 'y', 't') THEN 1 WHEN "monetary_relief" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END)) END) AS lmean, SUM(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM("monetary_relief")) IN ('1', '1.0', 'true', 'yes', 'y', 't') THEN 1 WHEN "monetary_relief" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN ln((CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM("monetary_relief")) IN ('1', '1.0', 'true', 'yes', 'y', 't') THEN 1 WHEN "monetary_relief" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END))*ln((CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM("monetary_relief")) IN ('1', '1.0', 'true', 'yes', 'y', 't') THEN 1 WHEN "monetary_relief" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END)) END) AS lsq FROM "consumer_complaints_2023" WHERE (CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM("monetary_relief")) IN ('1', '1.0', 'true', 'yes', 'y', 't') THEN 1 WHEN "monetary_relief" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END) IS NOT NULL AND "product" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY grp HAVING COUNT((CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM("monetary_relief")) IN ('1', '1.0', 'true', 'yes', 'y', 't') THEN 1 WHEN "monetary_relief" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END)) >= 10
